objective: Date-equal next-token cross entropy, averaged over coarse/fine heads and known forecast days. No plan labels.
selection: Independent selection-date token cross entropy; evaluation targets never select checkpoints.
normalization: Historical OHLC signal-factor anchor; historical-only per-window mean and population std plus 1e-5; clip 5.
unknown_targets: Known-valid prefix only; unknown suffix is masked, not imputed as a label.
tokenizer: Pinned frozen Kronos tokenizer; pretrained predictor not loaded; exact tokenizer pretraining dates unverified.
